records.title: Treat the project as a completely independent ground-zero system
Use Notion as the single source of truth for project meaning and status
Keep the caregiving safety core architecturally independent from the companion
Use a hybrid persistent-organism architecture as the working direction
Do not allow a language model to own canonical identity, state, memory, or safety authority
Maintain distinct homeostatic drives with explicit arbitration
Implement baby-like growth through developmental capability gates over safe pretrained priors
Use append-only evidence with typed, temporal, versioned derived memories
Treat dreaming as governed offline consolidation, not factual experience
Prohibit uncontrolled online foundation-model weight updates in the first implementation
Require perception systems to emit uncertain evidence rather than durable beliefs
Treat affect as a contextual hypothesis, never a directly observed fact or sole safety trigger
Make embodiment an engine-neutral adapter driven by causal intents
Require local survival and owner-portable creature continuity
Qualify named safety scenarios instead of building a generalized danger detector
Use explicit help requests and declared check-in deadlines as first safety-validation candidates
Adopt commodity infrastructure and inference; build the differentiating organism and safety logic
Do not initialize the production repository until the Research Phase 01 exit gate is satisfied
Reject a monolithic LLM-as-the-creature architecture
Reject behavior-tree-only and end-to-end reinforcement-learning-only organism architectures
Use a desktop-class Linux host for initial integrated research while preserving an appliance boundary
Run iteration one on the existing Linux PC and existing peripherals
Use Godot as the iteration-one embodiment engine
Pin Godot 4.7.2 stable as the initial implementation baseline
Represent the mon as an original project-authored 2D sprite system
Adopt MON_FRAME_V1 and a layered semantic sprite-clip pipeline
Keep Godot embodiment separate from canonical state and caregiving authority
Adopt Mon Visual Reference V1 as the canonical iteration-one identity
Approve the six-view turnaround sheet as an authoritative visual reference
Accept the Authority 3.0 governance-only repository bootstrap
Adopt the complete operational end goal as the project completion baseline
Begin Planning Phase 02 and govern delivery through the 16-phase master roadmap
